description: This file contains implementation of functions related to polygons and simplices in the Qhull library, including operations on facets, vertices, ridges, and their relationships, as well as functions for creating, attaching, deleting, and managing geometric structures used in convex hull computations.

methods.name: qh_appendfacet
methods.description: Appends a facet to the facet list in qh, updating related pointers and counters.

methods.name: qh_appendvertex
methods.description: Appends a vertex to the vertex list in qh, updating pointers and counters.

methods.name: qh_attachnewfacets
methods.description: Attaches horizon facets to new facets, updating ridges, neighbors, and internal links.

methods.name: qh_checkflipped
methods.description: Checks if a facet's orientation is flipped relative to the interior point, possibly restarting the algorithm.

methods.name: qh_delfacet
methods.description: Removes a facet from the facet list and frees associated memory.

methods.name: qh_deletevisible
methods.description: Deletes all visible facets and associated vertices, updating lists and counters.

methods.name: qh_facetintersect
methods.description: Returns the set of vertices representing the intersection of two facets, with skip indices.

methods.name: qh_gethash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a set, used for neighbor matching.

methods.name: qh_getreplacement
methods.description: Follows the replace chain of a facet to find its current valid replacement.

methods.name: qh_makenewfacet
methods.description: Creates a new facet with specified vertices, orientation, and horizon link.

methods.name: qh_makenewplanes
methods.description: Computes hyperplanes for new facets, possibly merging some.

methods.name: qh_makenew_nonsimplicial
methods.description: Creates new facets for ridges of a visible facet that are non-simplicial.

methods.name: qh_makenew_simplicial
methods.description: Creates new facets for a visible facet with an apex, assuming the facet is simplicial.

methods.name: qh_matchneighbor
methods.description: Matches a subridge of a new facet with an existing neighbor or adds it to a hash table.

methods.name: qh_matchnewfacets
methods.description: Matches all new facets to their neighbors, handling duplicate ridges and merging.

methods.name: qh_matchvertices
methods.description: Checks if two sets of vertices match with a single skip, and determines orientation.

methods.name: qh_newfacet
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new facet structure.

methods.name: qh_newridge
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new ridge structure.

methods.name: qh_newvertex
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new vertex structure.

methods.name: qh_pointid
methods.description: Returns the ID of a point, or special codes for interior or unknown points.

methods.name: qh_removefacet
methods.description: Unlinks a facet from the facet list.

methods.name: qh_removevertex
methods.description: Unlinks a vertex from the vertex list.

methods.name: qh_update_vertexneighbors
methods.description: Updates vertex neighbor lists and deletes interior vertices after modifications.

methods.name: qh_update_vertexneighbors_cone
methods.description: Updates vertex neighbors for a cone of new facets and deletes interior vertices.
